name: Ziing
notes: Colors: Black, Blue, White, Yellow, Orange and Light Blue use the named Figma paint styles from colorNames. Swatches #F0EEE1 (VariableID:7137:365), #FAFF5B (7137:368) and #C1BEBF (7137:369) are bound to variables whose names are not exposed and are labelled only by hex on the board, so descriptive fallback names were used: cream, bright-yellow, gray.

Typography: all 17 named text styles were captured once each from their specimen TEXT nodes. Letter spacing was converted from px to em (e.g. -2.2px/220px = -0.01em). Button Text uses Figma Auto line height (INTRINSIC_%), recorded as 'normal'; its documentation note says 21px (measured Auto = 20.88px). Resource stat header uses a fixed 66px line height. Source is underlined. No mobile sizes are documented.

Element mapping: h1-h4 map to Header 1 / Heading 2 / Header 3 / Header 4 based on their explicit header names. h5, h6 and p are null because no explicit semantic mapping is documented (Body 1 vs Body 2 is ambiguous).

Fonts: product typography uses only Neulis Sans (300, 400, 500, 600, 700), matched to the attached NeulisSans files. Inter and Lexend appear only in board labels and documentation and are excluded. The LIGA-off flag appears only on the 'Aa' font showcase specimens, so no feature flags were applied.

Button families: 'primary' is one shared structure: 50px-high pill, radius 25, padding 13/15, Button Text 16/600, label-to-icon gap 20, right-arrow glyph 20.37x17.58. Its five colorways (blue, black, yellow, orange, light-blue) are color-only variations; the black colorway uses white text and a white glyph. The hover is a split: transparent root, filled label pill (padding 14/14/15/15, radius 25), and a filled 50px icon circle in the same colour overlapping by -8px.

Button families: 'download' and 'external' reuse the primary structure and split hover but swap the glyph (download arrow 17.58x20.37; external-link arrow in a 26.83 box). 'play' (Watch video) has its own default structure: radius 28, padding 9/14/9/18 (encoded as root paddingX 14 plus label paddingLeft 4), gap 8, 24px play glyph. Its hover is the standard split with a 50px circle. 'icon' is icon-only: a 50px circle with the arrow glyph and identical default/hover frames, so no hover change is documented. 'link' is text plus arrow (600 18px/155%, blue arrow) whose only hover change is gap 10 to 15. 'inline' and 'inline-white' are Body 1 inline links with a 2px Light Blue underline 23px below the label top; on hover they add a Light Blue 30%-opacity highlight (24px high, offset 1px).

Button cap: the schema allows at most 12 buttons, so these observed permutations were not emitted separately: Download button in the blue colorway (10008:17573 / hover 10008:17584), External link button in the black colorway (10008:17596 / 10008:17608), icon-only blue circle with a black arrow (7156:13219 / 7156:13228), and the text link with a black arrow (10008:17618 / 10008:17625). Each combines a retained structure with a retained palette colour.

Icons: the Icons section's black arrow group (7169:13271) matches Arrow-Right 1 (7905:986) in size and paint and reuses the 'arrow-right' asset. Button-only glyph colourings are exported from their own nodes: arrow-right-white 7169:13274, arrow-right-blue 10008:17617, arrow-download-white 10008:17571, arrow-external-link-white 10008:17600 (exports as a 26.83px rotated box). The black download and external-link button glyphs reuse Arrow-Download 1 (7905:982) and Arrow-ExternalLink 1 (7905:984), which have matching dimensions. The '-Square' industry icons are multi-colour 44px tiles.

Brand/logo: the Ziing horizontal logo (7169:13262) is the logo and the 32px blue tile mark (7169:13256) is the favicon. The Eight25 credit group (7136:11808) is classified as brand artwork; its logo is an IMAGE fill, so the SVG export will embed raster data.

Spacing is copied from spacingEvidence (default e25-spacing-v1 scale; variables unavailable). Radii, breakpoints and container use the supplied defaults. The measured button radii (25 and 28) are carried on the button specs, and the 5px swatch radius matches the default xs.
The host exports each item in labeled icon/logo rows, including unnamed vectors. Button paints are read from the mapped Figma states; empty fills stay transparent.
Styles use the selected breakpoint system. Generate the E25 padded Container separately after applying the style guide. Google families use next/font/google; custom families use the attached files.
Figma variables could not be read. Using the default 30-token spacing scale and its spacing safelist.
